convert_yaml_to_csv: convert a cloc YAML file into a CSV file for BigQuery ingestion
parse_yaml_input: parse a YAML file from the command line input argument and load its data
filter_third_party: filter out third_party entries, header, and SUM rows from the YAML data
write_csv_output: write filtered YAML data rows to a CSV file with date, name, language, code, comment, and blank columns
run_yaml2csv_cli: run the yaml2csv CLI tool with an input YAML file, optional date, and output CSV path
